subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a portable processing-feedback lifecycle for ordinary agent turns, or leave visible acknowledgment placeholders as independent channel-plugin features?
rationale: The UX need is well supported, but current main offers several incompatible presentation mechanisms and no canonical semantics for cleanup, silent replies, failure, concurrency, or final-message replacement.

options.title: Portable lifecycle seam
options.body: Add typed processing-start, update, and finish intent while channel plugins own transport-specific rendering and cleanup.

options.title: Channel-local features
options.body: Keep Slack, Discord, Telegram, Feishu, WhatsApp, and WebChat implementations independent with channel-specific configuration.

options.title: Static global ack text
options.body: Add only a shared acknowledgment string and scope without standardized edit, failure, concurrency, or cleanup behavior.

recommendation.title: Portable lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Add typed processing-start, update, and finish intent while channel plugins own transport-specific rendering and cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest broad routing signal combines recent cross-channel reply-lifecycle work with prior direct review of this issue.
